name: boringstack-docs
description: boringstack.xyz docs site for the BoringStack project. Astro Starlight, deployed via Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.generate:docs-data: bun run generate:lint-meta-docs && bun run generate:scripts-docs && bun run generate:scaffold-manifest
scripts.check:docs-data: bun run check:lint-meta-docs && bun run check:scripts-docs && bun run check:scaffold-manifest
scripts.build:site: bun run generate:scaffold-manifest && bun run generate:og-image && astro build && bun run sanitize:llms
scripts.build: bun run generate:scaffold-manifest && bun run generate:og-image && astro build && bun run sanitize:llms
scripts.build:ci: bun run check:docs-data && bun run check:components && astro build && bun run sanitize:llms && bun run check:fragments && bun run check:rendered-markdown && bun run check:agent-surface

//overrides._: Why these transitive deps are pinned. Build-time/dev tooling only — the deployed site is static Cloudflare Pages. Re-evaluate quarterly (see osv-scanner.toml).
//overrides.adm-zip: Pin patched adm-zip (GHSA-xcpc-8h2w-3j85, then GHSA-7q85-xj36-vmfc, GHSA-8238-w5pm-2374, GHSA-c6fg-446q-cg94, GHSA-j5f4-cc29-5x44, GHSA-p634-w6r4-rjp2, GHSA-rcw4-f5rp-g42v). 0.6.0 is vulnerable; 0.6.1 patches them. Build-time tooling only (wrangler/miniflare archive handling).
//overrides.axios: Pin patched axios (GHSA-gcfj-64vw-6mp9 and related, then GHSA-r4gj-5m52-g5wh, GHSA-vh66-26gq-q6x8, GHSA-x97p-jq2g-jp4f). 1.18.0 is vulnerable; 1.20.0 patches it. Build-time tooling only. Mirrors the API app pin.
//overrides.dompurify: Pin patched DOMPurify (GHSA-c2j3-45gr-mqc4, GHSA-55q2-fjhq-7xh7, then GHSA-6688-9rhm-gjv2, GHSA-p98j-92pf-mc4p). 3.4.13 is vulnerable; 3.4.16 patches them. Pulled via mermaid diagram rendering; diagram source is author-controlled.
//overrides.js-yaml: Pin patched js-yaml (GHSA-52cp-r559-cp3m, GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh). 4.3.1 is vulnerable (maxTotalMergeKeys CPU exhaustion); 4.3.2 patches it. Build-time config loading only. Mirrors the UI app pin.
//overrides.postcss: Pin patched postcss (GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849). 8.5.18 is vulnerable (GHSA-fxqj-rqcc-2cmp); 8.5.23 patches it. Build-time CSS tooling via vite/tailwind.
//overrides.sharp: Collapse transitive sharp@0.34.5 (GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj) onto the direct sharp@0.35.5 pin. 0.35.3 and 0.35.4 are vulnerable (GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c, GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w); 0.35.5 patches them. Image processing at build time only.
//overrides.svgo: Pin patched svgo (GHSA-2p49-hgcm-8545, GHSA-w27v-7q3p-w38r, GHSA-4vpr-x523-8j87). 4.0.2 is vulnerable; 4.1.0 patches it. SVG optimization at build time only.
//overrides.ws: Pin patched ws (GHSA-58qx-3vcg-4xpx) pulled via miniflare/wrangler dev tooling.
//overrides.devalue: Pin patched devalue (GHSA-77vg-94rm-hx3p, then GHSA-4q55-j62x-fr9h, GHSA-9rgm-9g3h-6x36, GHSA-hx4r-w6wj-j8fg, GHSA-j22f-vq7h-c4qm, GHSA-mcm9-63f2-9j32, GHSA-r9w8-h9r3-54w4, GHSA-wf3x-273g-mvxv, GHSA-x5rw-q4pp-hg5g). 5.8.1 is vulnerable; 5.9.3 patches them. Pulled in by Astro. Build-time serialization only.
//overrides.qs: Pin patched qs (GHSA-q8mj-m7cp-5q26, GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g, GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx). 6.15.2 is vulnerable; 6.16.0 patches it. Pulled via the http-server dev preview tool. Mirrors the UI app pin.
//overrides.tmp: Pin patched tmp (GHSA-7c78-jf6q-g5cm type-confusion path traversal); 0.2.6 is now vulnerable, 0.2.7 patches it. Transitive dev-tooling dep. Mirrors the UI app pin.
//overrides.form-data: Pin patched form-data (GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx CRLF injection); 4.0.5 is vulnerable, 4.0.6 patches it. Build-time tooling only (wrangler/astro fetches). Mirrors the API app pin. Excluded from the install quarantine while <7 days old.
//overrides.undici: Pin patched undici (GHSA-vmh5-mc38-953g TLS cert-validation bypass, GHSA-pr7r-676h-xcf6, the 7.29.0 batch, and GHSA-3wwx-pv8p-q78v fixed in 7.29.1). Build-time tooling only (wrangler/astro fetches). Mirrors the UI app pin. 7.29.0 is vulnerable.
//overrides.@types/react: Match the UI app's @types/react pin so React types resolve identically across apps (@astrojs/react pulls them transitively here).
//overrides.@types/react-dom: Match the UI app's @types/react-dom pin for the same cross-app type parity.
//overrides.basic-ftp: Pin patched basic-ftp (GHSA-c475-qrg2-pj4r, CPU exhaustion parsing a directory listing). 5.3.1 is vulnerable; 6.2.1 patches it. Build-time tooling only. Mirrors the UI app pin.
//overrides.ip-address: Pin patched ip-address (GHSA-2vr4-cq9g-pvrc, GHSA-rpw4-54j3-4h4q, GHSA-h3mg-xc3c-68pw, GHSA-j6r3-76f7-8jcv). 10.4.0 is vulnerable; 10.7.2 patches them. Transitive via socks in wrangler tooling. Mirrors the UI app pin.
//overrides.katex: Pin patched KaTeX (GHSA-238p-pmpm-9mq7, read-side prototype pollution gadget). 0.16.47 is vulnerable; 0.18.2 patches it. Mermaid pins ^0.16.47, so this is a deliberate forced major-line bump; verified by the docs build. Build-time and diagram rendering only.
//overrides.postcss-nested: Pin postcss-nested 7.x so the tree resolves postcss-selector-parser 7.x (GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf, quadratic flat-selector parsing in 6.1.4). @expressive-code/core pins postcss-nested ^6.0.1; 7.0.2 is the upstream pairing with postcss-selector-parser ^7. Build-time CSS for code blocks only.
//overrides.smol-toml: Pin patched smol-toml (GHSA-r4xh-jqrq-34v2). 1.7.1 is vulnerable; 1.9.0 patches it. Transitive via astro (build-time config parsing). Mirrored in every app by the override-parity rule.
//overrides.source-map-js: Pin patched source-map-js (GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q). 1.2.1 is vulnerable; 1.2.2 patches it. Transitive via postcss / build tooling. Mirrored in every app by the override-parity rule.
